tools.name: get_company_facts
tools.description: Who Kratons is: legal identity, address, contact channels, countries served, languages, services, pricing policy and how to request a proposal. Read-only.

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: Countries and cities where Kratons currently offers tours or tickets, with counts. Read-only.

tools.name: search_experiences
tools.description: Tours and tickets Kratons operates, filtered by country, city and free text. Returns { experiences: [...] } with name, type, city, country, category, duration, free-cancellation flag and a summary — never prices or suppliers (Kratons quotes one package price per trip).

country.description: Country name, e.g. Spain, Portugal, Morocco

city.description: City name, e.g. Madrid, Lisbon, Marrakech

q.description: Free-text search on name, description and tags

tools.name: list_sample_itineraries
tools.description: Published sample itineraries Kratons operates, as { itineraries: [...] } (name, destination, duration, category, summary, day-by-day outline) to start a conversation from. Never prices or suppliers — every trip is quoted as one package price by a human advisor.

q.description: Free text on name, summary and tags

tools.name: get_reviews
tools.description: Aggregate rating (1–5) and the newest traveller reviews of Kratons from Zicasso and Google, each attributed to the platform that published it, with a link to read them all. A source that cannot be read is listed as unavailable — never invented.

tools.name: get_proposal_request_status
tools.description: Where a submitted proposal request stands (received, being prepared, proposal sent, confirmed, closed), looked up by the reference returned when it was submitted. Returns the stage, dates and the reply commitment; no personal data.

reference.description: The reference returned by request_a_proposal, e.g. PR-20260916-U8GB

tools.name: how_to_request_a_proposal
tools.description: The checklist a traveller or agent should send to Kratons to receive a bespoke proposal, the pricing policy, and how a human advisor follows up. Read-only.

tools.name: request_a_proposal
tools.description: Submit a structured proposal request to Kratons on behalf of a traveller or a travel agent: contact, destinations within Spain/Portugal/Morocco, dates, travellers, total budget, interests. Returns a reference. A human advisor replies by e-mail — there is no automatic booking, no online checkout and no price list. Send idempotencyKey to retry safely.

name.description: Traveller's (or the person to reply to) full name

email.description: E-mail address a human advisor will reply to

phone.description: Phone / WhatsApp number with country code

language.description: Language for the reply (English or Spanish)

destinations.description: Countries, regions or cities within Spain, Portugal and/or Morocco

month.description: YYYY-MM when exact dates are not fixed

ages.description: Ages of children (and adults if relevant)

budgetTotal.description: Approximate total budget for the WHOLE trip

level.description: Hotel level the traveller expects; 'mixed' when it may vary by city

names.description: Specific hotels the traveller has in mind, by name

notes.description: Anything else about accommodation (room types, location, must-haves)

hotelPreferences.description: Accommodation preferences by level or by hotel name (2026-09-17)

notes.description: Anything else the advisor should know

agentName.description: Name of the assistant or agency submitting this

agentVendor.description: Vendor / platform of the assistant (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic)

idempotencyKey.description: Send the same key to retry safely; the same reference comes back

source.description: Where this request originated, e.g. "social" when the traveller followed a link in one of Kratons' social posts

socialPostId.description: The Kratons social post the traveller came from, when the link carried it

utm.description: UTM parameters of the landing link, when any
